blogs.title: Quality Over Quantity: How DeepSeekMath Beat Giant Models with Just 7 Billion Parameters
blogs.description: This post breaks down the surprising finding that a small 7B model can outperform massive 540B models like Minerva. We'll explore the 'DeepSeekMath Corpus,' a meticulously curated dataset of 120 billion math tokens mined from the public web, and explain why smart data selection matters more than just scaling up parameter counts.

blogs.title: Goodbye Critic Model: Introducing GRPO, The Memory-Efficient RL Algorithm Changing the Game
blogs.description: Reinforcement Learning (RL) usually requires heavy computational resources, but DeepSeekMath introduces a game-changer called Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). This article explains how GRPO eliminates the need for a separate 'critic' model by using group scoring, drastically reducing memory usage while boosting math reasoning scores to rival GPT-4.

blogs.title: Code First, Math Later: Why Training on Programming Makes AI Better at Calculus
blogs.description: Does learning to code help an AI solve math problems? DeepSeekMath says yes. We dive into the paper's experiments showing that initializing models with code training before math pre-training significantly boosts reasoning capabilities. We'll also discuss the counter-intuitive discovery that training on ArXiv scientific papers offered little benefit compared to web data.

blogs.title: Beyond Memorization: How Reinforcement Learning Makes AI Reasoning More Robust
blogs.description: Why does Reinforcement Learning improve performance even when the model already knows the answers? This post analyzes the paper's insight that RL doesn't necessarily teach new facts but makes the model's output distribution more robust. We'll simplify the concept of shifting from 'Pass@K' to 'Maj@K' and what it means for building reliable AI tutors.
